name: Minang Bioscience Journal (MBJ)
shortDesc: Minang Bioscience Journal (MBJ)  is an international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal dedicated to research and innovation in biological sciences, including biodiversity, ecology, biotechnology, environmental science, and emerging biological technologies.

name: Minang Chemistry Journal (MCJ)
shortDesc: Minang Chemistry Journal (MCJ)  is an international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal publishing high-quality research in chemistry and its interdisciplinary applications. MCJ provides a global platform for researchers to share innovative findings and contribute to the advancement of chemical sciences and sustainable development.

name: Minang Computer Science Journal (MCSJ)
shortDesc: Minang Computer Science Journal (MCSJ)  is a scientific journal that publishes research and innovative studies in Computer Science, Informatics, and Information Technology, covering topics such as Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, Computer Networks, Cybersecurity, Internet of Things (IoT), and related fields. The journal provides a platform for researchers, academics, students, and practitioners to disseminate scientific knowledge and technological developments through a peer-review process.

name: Minang Mathematics Journal (MMJ)
shortDesc: Minang Mathematics Journal (MMJ)  is an international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal that publishes research in mathematics and related fields. MMJ provides a platform for researchers, academics, and practitioners to share innovative mathematical research and its applications.

name: Minang Physics Journal (MPJ)
shortDesc: Minang Physics Journal (MPJ)  is an international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal that publishes research in physics and its interdisciplinary applications. The journal provides a platform for researchers and academics to share scientific findings and developments in physical sciences.
